title: Environment record frontmatter (environment-v1)
description: Frontmatter contract for knowledge/environment/*.md. Facts only, no executable commands in metadata, no credentials. The Markdown body holds the concise prose; metadata is for identity, scoping, provenance and relations. Enforced by extensions/mission-stack/environment-source.ts.

id.description: Stable unique record id. Must be unique across all records.

aliases.description: Alternate lookup keys resolved before lexical/semantic fallback.

scopes.description: Distinct applicable environments/paths within one record (e.g. workstation vs eks-workload). Keeps same-named facts in different environments separate.

sources.description: Where each fact was verified from (referenced, not copied). AWS inventory stays a reference, never a copied account list.

verified_at.description: ISO date the facts were last verified. Drives freshness warnings.

relations.description: Typed links to other records. Targets must resolve to an existing record id (no dangling references).
